description: In crates/core/src/audit.rs flush_buffer, each AuditEvent in the batch is inserted with a separate sqlx::query(...).execute(&mut *tx) call inside a for-loop. For a batch of N events this is N round-trips to SQLite inside a single transaction, but each round-trip still incurs prepare+bind+step overhead. A VALUES multi-row INSERT or QueryBuilder::push_values reduces this to a single statement. See the pattern already used in sqlite_storage.rs set_tips (lines 216-221) for the idiomatic approach.
title: audit flush_buffer: one INSERT per event instead of bulk INSERT
